controls.name: reexecute-identical-retry
controls.claim: Independent durable execution probe, with identical result, write and release behavior.
controls.from: if (recorded.move_as_ok() == td::KeyValue::GetStatus::Ok) return read_and_release(identity, admitted_input, observer);
controls.to: if (recorded.move_as_ok() == td::KeyValue::GetStatus::Ok) { auto repeated = build(); if (repeated.is_error()) return absent(repeated.move_as_error()); return read_and_release(identity, admitted_input, observer); }

controls.name: rewrite-identical-retry
controls.claim: Extra durable write without re-execution or changed bytes.
controls.from: if (recorded.move_as_ok() == td::KeyValue::GetStatus::Ok) return read_and_release(identity, admitted_input, observer);
controls.to: if (recorded.move_as_ok() == td::KeyValue::GetStatus::Ok) { auto repeated = decode(previous, limits_.max_bundle_bytes); if (repeated.is_error()) return unavailable(repeated.move_as_error()); return write(repeated.ok(), observer); }

controls.name: reinstall-identical-view
controls.claim: Passive release idempotence; values remain identical.

controls.name: remove-read-observation
controls.claim: Same read observation guard in normal and cold recovery entry points.

controls.name: remove-new-release-observation
controls.claim: Same release observation guard in both entry points; bootstrap observation retained.

controls.name: normalize-external-count
controls.claim: External count fidelity, independent of I13a semantic validity.

controls.name: retain-old-message-bytes
controls.claim: Actual message reader compares frozen payload and queue metadata.
controls.to: auto altered = bundle; if (auto prior = released_.load()) altered.pending_messages = prior->pending_messages; auto encoded = encode(altered, limits_.max_bundle_bytes);

controls.name: drift-account-bytes
controls.claim: Full state bytes; cold-reader identity 207 includes complete state observation.
controls.to: auto altered = bundle; if (released_.load()) altered.components[0] += "drift"; auto encoded = encode(altered, limits_.max_bundle_bytes);

controls.name: expose-view-while-undetermined
controls.claim: Current reader refuses unresolved storage state.
controls.from: if (recovery_required_.load()) return td::Status::Error(local_unavailable, "publication read requires recovery");

controls.name: execute-while-undetermined
controls.claim: No execution or retry before persistent resolution.

controls.name: infer-absence-from-reopen-error
controls.claim: Unavailable recovery must not mean absent.

controls.name: erase-store-binding
controls.claim: Actual store identity, not an implicitly new recovery store.

controls.name: erase-completed-sync-counter
controls.claim: Successful underlying sync must be observed before synthetic EIO.

controls.name: disable-commit-point-io-fault
controls.claim: Real commit-point I/O control is active; this is instrument calibration.

controls.name: erase-execution-probe
controls.claim: Independent execution counter cannot silently disappear.

controls.name: disable-partial-write-fault
controls.claim: Partial-write runtime instrument must be active; no writer-status inference.

controls.name: disable-prewrite-cancellation
controls.claim: Before-write cancellation actually occurs, not an unexercised label.

controls.name: disable-postcommit-crash
controls.claim: Cold recovery scenario must terminate before its first release.

controls.name: mark-record-set-error-ready
controls.claim: Known non-commit does not make a local record-set error Ready.

controls.name: mark-head-set-error-ready
controls.claim: Known non-commit does not make a local head-set error Ready.

controls.name: erase-set-error-probe
controls.claim: The actual backend set boundary must be crossed before error substitution.

controls.name: disable-set-error-injection
controls.claim: API-boundary status injection, not a physical disk failure claim.

controls.name: alter-set-error-identity
controls.claim: Classification and originating numerical status are checked separately.

controls.name: allow-missing-store-creation
controls.claim: A missing recovery store cannot be silently recreated even if its marker then fails.

scope: Private RocksDb publication and passive immutable readers. No live host integration, activation, finality or permission to send. D31 provider allocation/history bounds remain open. Runtime I/O controls cover isolated WAL operations and actual reopen, not every power-loss failure. No production VmVirtError classification or I13 acceptance is established.
